causes.label: demand
causes.quote: High temperatures in Victoria drove higher than forecast demand with Melbourne's maximum temperature reaching 37°C.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Following the loss of the major transmission lines, several generation units tripped removing around 2,500 MW of low-priced generation in the region.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: At around 1.10 pm, the Moorabool-Sydenham No.1 and No.2 500 kilovolt (kV) lines tripped with reports that the transmission towers were on the ground.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: All connecting regions were exporting into Victoria during the high price periods (excluding load shedding periods) although were limited due to network constraints.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: Not all these constraints could be satisfied, which led to them violating and being the major price setter for the 1.20 pm, 1.25 pm and 1.30 pm dispatch intervals.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: When involuntary customer load shedding occurs, the price is set at the price cap.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of capacity due to plant limitations and outages contributed to some of the high price intervals.
